verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents several public programmatic interfaces: official drivers and SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java; a Postgres-compatible endpoint; a Wasm client library; and a remote MCP server with read-only and read-write SQL tools. A probe also found a published OpenAPI spec at motherduck.com/openapi.json. Missing for 10: detail on what the OpenAPI/REST surface covers (for example account or management operations beyond SQL), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through these APIs.
